messages:
support_lead: Customer report — hosted API returning surge of 5xx/504s for tenant acme-inc, started ~23:50 UTC. Customer says timeouts on inference requests. Escalating.
customer_success: Customer called support, they're seeing repeated 504s and long tail latency during bursts. Provided sample req_id req_0a1b2c and timeline.
eng_oncall: Looking now. Any immediate throttles or billing alerts? Share req id and traces.
support_lead: req_id=req_0a1b2c trace=https://console.internal/traces/req_0a1b2c. Error in gateway logs: "upstream request timeout" then "no healthy upstream". Attached excerpt.
sre_anna: Observing metric gaps — KEDA metrics adapter stopped reporting queue-depth for namespace acme at 23:45. Many metric-adapter scrapes returning 401/403. HPA shows stable replicas=1.
infra_jordan: Correlating infra logs: token-rotator job attempted refresh at 23:44 and received 429s from billing/token service (quota throttled). Token expired, so metrics-adapter auth failed -> 401 on subsequent scrapes.
ops-bot: pagerduty:incident-614 created (severity P1) · @eng_oncall notified.
eng_oncall: Quick mitigation: bump scaledobject replicaCount and create a manual burst of pods to absorb queue while we triage. Kicking off now.
support_lead: Notified customer about mitigation. They reported fewer 504s after ~120s. Thanks. :thumbsup:
marta: Flag: we need a fallback metric source for KEDA when metric-adapter fails. Prometheus scrape or fallback to queue length via consumer lag.
sre_anna: Repro steps for engineering: 1) force token rotation to return 429 from billing service; 2) observe token-rotator fail -> metrics-adapter auth gap; 3) KEDA stops receiving queue metric -> scaledobject stays at 1 -> requests queue up -> gateway timeouts.
eng_oncall: Relevant logs snippet: 
```
ERROR token-rotator: refresh failed status=429 body="Quota exceeded for billing account x"
WARN metrics-adapter: auth failed status=401 token missing
INFO keda: no metrics for ScaledObject acme-req-queue
ERROR gateway: upstream request timeout req_id=req_0a1b2c
```
infra_jordan: Root cause summary: interplay of token-rotation + billing quota throttle caused a metrics ingestion gap. That in turn prevented KEDA/HPA from scaling. Secondary factor: model init warmup is ~18s while gateway SLO is 10s, so delayed pods still caused 504s.
eng_oncall: Short-term fixes applied: reverted token-rotation to last-good token, manual scaledobject bump, hotstarted 8 pods in acme namespace, increased gateway retry window for tenant. Observed 90% reduction in 5xx.
sre_anna: Long-term action items: [A] add backoff + retry + alerting to token-rotator (owner: infra_jordan), [B] implement KEDA fallback metric source and alert when metrics drop (owner: sre_anna), [C] add prewarm pool or keep-alive small replica set for high-burst tenants (owner: eng_oncall), [D] review billing token quotas and add monitoring/alerts (owner: finance-infra).
support_lead: Owners assigned and customer updated with RCA summary and ETA for fixes. Marking this thread for postmortem if follow-ups escalate.
marta: +1 on postmortem, also propose runbook change: if metrics ingestion gap detected, temporarily scale to target replicaCount and notify CS auto.
eng_oncall: Will prepare short postmortem and remediation PRs. Adding links to tracelog and dashboards in follow-up. :eyes:
support_lead: Closing incident thread in slack after action items tracked in Jira (INC-7892). Customer acknowledged the update and dropped to monitoring.
